command.abortCommit: Generate Commit Message with Kenari - Stop
config.title: Kenari Copilot
config.commitLanguage.desc: Language for generated Git commit messages. When set to "auto", the language is detected from recent commit history. Defaults to English if no history exists.
config.commitLanguage.auto.desc: Auto-detect language from recent commit history (defaults to English)
config.commitModel.desc: Model ID used for commit message generation.
config.commitMessagePrompt.desc: Custom system prompt for commit message generation.
config.requestTimeout.desc: Maximum time (in milliseconds) for a single request. Default: 600000 (10 minutes). Increase if you encounter timeout errors with long responses.
config.recentCommitsCount.desc: Number of recent commits to analyze for style reference when generating commit messages. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 10.
config.commitIncludeCommitDiff.desc: When enabled, include the actual code changes (diff) of recent commits in the style reference, helping the model generate messages that better match the project's commit style. Default: false.
config.commitAttachContextFiles.desc: When enabled, attach the content of AGENTS.md and README.md from the repository root as additional context for commit message generation, helping the model better understand the project. Default: true.
config.modelPreset.desc: Current model preset ID. Use the 'Set Model Preset' command to select a preset. Set to 'custom' to use manual values from 'kenari.temperature' and 'kenari.top_p'.
config.temperature.desc: Model temperature (0.0 - 2.0). Paired with 'kenari.top_p'. Only used when 'kenari.modelPreset' is set to 'custom'.
config.top_p.desc: Model top_p (0.0 - 1.0). Paired with 'kenari.temperature'. Only used when 'kenari.modelPreset' is set to 'custom'.
config.modelListRefreshInterval.desc: Cache TTL in milliseconds for the Kenari model list (GET /v1/models). The list is public and cheap to fetch; the short TTL keeps new models appearing without an extension update. Default: 60000 (1 minute). Minimum: 30000 (30 seconds).
config.inferenceBaseUrl.desc: **Advanced.** Overrides the base URL used for inference requests (chat and Git commit message generation) to route them through a self-hosted proxy/gateway (observability, key routing, compression, etc.). The proxy must be fully compatible with the official Kenari endpoint: identical protocols (OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages), paths, request/response formats, model IDs, and headers (including `Authorization`). Account quota and model list requests always use the official endpoint. Prefer the 'Set Proxy Base URL' command, which shows a compatibility notice before setting the value. Leave empty to use the official endpoint.
config.modelPresets.desc: Model presets for quick selection via command palette. Each preset includes temperature and top_p. You can customize the presets.
config.modelPreset.id.desc: Preset identifier (must match the value in modelPreset setting).
config.visionProxyModel.desc: Vision model ID used by the ask_image tool to answer questions about attached images when the selected model does not support vision. Any vision-capable Kenari model works; the default qwen3-7-plus follows the historical Qwen-Plus default.
config.visionProxyThinking.desc: Enable thinking/reasoning in the vision proxy model when answering image queries.
config.enableThirdPartyTokenIndicator.de: Enable the Advanced Token indicator in the status bar. The native Copilot token indicator always shows. When this is enabled, the extension also shows an advanced token counter in the VS Code status bar. Default: true.
config.delay.desc: Delay in milliseconds between consecutive API requests to avoid rate limiting. Set to 0 for no delay. Default: 0.
config.visionMaxRounds.desc: Maximum number of vision proxy rounds for non-vision models using the `ask_image` tool to query images. Limits follow-up queries per request. Default: 5.
config.showUsageInTooltip.desc: Show the Kenari plan quota (weekly / monthly utilization, reset countdowns, coupon and balance) in the status bar tooltip, refreshed in the background. Clicking the status bar item or running 'Kenari: Check Kenari Plan Quota' forces an immediate refresh. Default: true.
config.usageRefreshInterval.desc: How often (in minutes) the Kenari plan quota is refreshed in the background (1-60). The account endpoints are rate limited (60 requests/minute per account); keep this at 5 minutes or more. Default: 5.
config.readFileLines.desc: Default number of lines for the `read_file` tool. When set to a positive value, the extension automatically adjusts `read_file` tool calls to read this many lines. Set to 0 for no adjustment. Default: 0.
config.retry.enabled.desc: Enable automatic retry with exponential backoff for failed API requests. Default: true.
config.retry.maxAttempts.desc: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed API requests. Default: 3.
config.retry.intervalMs.desc: Initial delay in milliseconds before the first retry attempt. Increases exponentially with each retry. Default: 1000.
config.retry.statusCodes.desc: Additional HTTP status codes that trigger automatic retry beyond the default set (429, 500, 502, 503, 504). Default: [].
config.enableCommitGeneration.desc: Show the generate commit message button in the SCM panel. When disabled, the magic wand button and the command palette entry are hidden.
